title: Fase E-1 — Versioned SQL-migration system pilot (trade-ui: migrate.py + schema_migrations + 001_baseline + slim init_db.py)
design_notes: Fase E establishes a versioned SQL-migration system replacing init_db.py's inline CREATE/ALTER monolith. Problem: no schema_migrations table means the system can't tell which schema version a DB is at — caused the 2026-07-04 DB-loss incident (restore resurrected dead start_cmd/start_cmd_suffix columns that had been DROPped, because init_db.py re-added them on re-run, causing a live dispatch.py regression). Fase E: scripts/db/*.sql numbered migrations + schema_migrations table + scripts/migrate.py idempotent runner. Makes schema evolution tracked/replayable/rollback-able, and makes Fase F legacy-table cleanup SAFE (drops become reviewed migrations). Pilot scope: trade-ui ONLY (init_db.py 2236 lines, 22 tables, 7 ALTER, 44 INSERTs) — smaller than Father (5281 lines, 48 tables), cloud_pay flow warmed up. Father replication = Fase E-2 via strict_review (separate later handoff). Design: (1) migrate.py resolves DB via config.get_db_path(), creates schema_migrations table, applies pending scripts/db/*.sql in numeric order transactionally with applied_at tracking, idempotent; (2) 001_baseline.sql = current 22-table schema as CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS (collapses historical CREATE+ALTER churn into one baseline; no-op on existing DB, creates on fresh); (3) init_db.py slimmed to call migrate.py (schema) + keep idempotent INSERT OR IGNORE for canonical data seed (i18n labels, conventions — the 44 data INSERTs); remove inline CREATE/ALTER (now in baseline). Backward-compatible: python3 scripts/init_db.py still works (app.py:317 message + run_etoro_tests.py:47 call valid). init_db.py invoked MANUALLY (not at app startup) — no app-startup wiring needed. Baseline = current state (not historical replay) — the 7 ALTERs are collapsed into baseline. schema_migrations is metadata (no app code reads it; only migrate.py). No data loss (IF NOT EXISTS). Sacred invariants untouched. Handoff 58 dispatched to imple01pay; NOT committed until Human verdict. Fase F (legacy cleanup) follows after E-1 lands — drops become 002_drop_*.sql migrations.
